gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing. Statement debt_proceeds 31,661,625 (p4) = the four printed 'Issuance of Debt' cells already in detail[]: General 8,020,000 + Street Construction 5,810,000 (p4) + 13,900,000 (p19, nonmajor capital projects) + 3,931,625 = 31,661,625. The schedule figure 32,107,352 also counts the two p4 'Leases' cells, West Haymarket JPA 378,098 + Federal Grants 67,629 = 445,727, which the JSON statement keeps in other_financing (computed: premium 1,728,145 + leases 445,727 + subscriptions 1,140,810 + sale of capital assets 215,871). 31,661,625 + 445,727 = 32,107,352. So the gap is only where lease financing is counted (debt proceeds vs other financing), not a missing or duplicated line. All other printed other-financing cells are already in detail[] and tie: premium 278,199 + 356,997 + 849,415 + 243,534 = 1,728,145; subscriptions 423,231 + 717,579 = 1,140,810; sale of capital assets 20,175 + 6,000 + 19,276 + 90,000 + 2 + 79,933 + 485 = 215,871. No transfer line is labelled the wrong way round.
